Dialogs.Dialog: (Oh right！ Maybe I'll invite her on the Hakone trip I won...)
Actually, I won a trip again！
Really!? Then, um... another school trip？
Nope, this time it's a honeymoon！ "Rediscovering the Domestic Honeymoon": two days and one night in Hakone!!
"Rediscovering the Domestic Honeymoon," two days and one night in Hakone.
Oh, right！ Speaking of which, Captain Tezuka said that for the next doubles...
...Could it be you're pretending not to hear me, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Well, because we're... not yet... and I...
It might be old-fashioned, but I think a honeymoon should come after getting married...
Yeah... you're not newlyweds unless you're married... no, that's not it！
Apparently in the late 1950s and early '60s, honeymoons meant Hakone or Atami.
It's a tour for young couples to go sightsee those places again, apparently.
Then it's... just a trip with that theme？
Then, in other words, it's, um...
Does it bother you after all？
I see... then, maybe if you feel like it？
When I thought about it, it's just a trip to Hakone, right？
Whether we make it like a honeymoon, well, that's up to us, it could be the same as usual...
Right, right！ It's the same as usual.
All right！ Then when should we go？
(Um, let's make the date some other day...)
Then, from ▲月▲▲日▲, a two-day, one-night honeymoon！
Ah, I mean... a honeymoon-themed Hakone trip！
If that's the theme, maybe we could be a little closer than usual... Just kidding.
(Yes!! A Hakone trip for me and ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
(Oh right！ Maybe I'll invite her on the Hakone trip I won again...)
Actually, I won it again, the honeymoon！
Um, you know... a two-day, one-night Hakone trip with that theme.
Yes... it's practice, so it's fine. No matter how many times...
All right！ Then when should we go？
(Dates can be another day. Practice is important, after all...)
Then, from ▲月▲▲日▲, a two-day, one-night honeymoon！
A Hakone trip to practice for the honeymoon！
(Yes!! A Hakone trip for me and ▲高嶺＊＊▲！)
Um, about our trip, you know, the upcoming one...
Yeah, the honeym―― I mean, the Hakone trip？
Yes. You know, want to go shopping？ Right now.
Sure, but... it's one night, you know？ Do we need anything？
No？ I just thought maybe we should practice starting from that kind of thing...
If it were a real honeymoon, what would we need？ Let's look around？
Oh, I see... all right, let's go look！
It wasn't really any different from usual, huh？
Really？ I made one discovery. That the two of us can share one big bag.
Oh, right！ Being newlyweds means we'd be going home to the same place, huh？
Right... and I'm sure we'd pack together too.
That practice was fun. Now I'm even more excited for the trip.
Ah, I still have something to do... go home first？
You don't have any real shopping, right？
True, but I still have practice shopping left...
That's okay！ Um, it's solo practice... bye-bye.
(Brides must have all sorts of things, I bet...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Morning. Did I keep you waiting？
Still, it's already muggy this morning...
Hehe, it's June. Hey, what's the sixth month called in English？
No reason. People often say "June" something, so...
Mornings are already a little chilly, huh？
Yes. I'm sure Hakone's even colder. And the autumn leaves, too.
A honeymoon among the autumn leaves！
It'd be nice if it were like that... even for practice, romantic is lovelier...
▲高嶺＊＊▲... all right, shall we set off？
No, on the Romancecar▼ When I went with my family, we went by car.
Ah, this is... um, the 30000 series EXE！
Yes. It's the sixth generation, also used for commuting, and the most numerous model, apparently.
I see, we're riding the EXE... hehe♪
You're that excited about the Romancecar？
Um, of course, not just that, Hakone too...
Well, riding the limited express is part of the fun too！
That's right！ Exciting, isn't it？ The Romancecar♪
Right. The 30000 series. Hey, let's get on！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ sure gets hyped when it comes to trains...)
The seats are wide, so we're a little far apart, right？ Right？
But there's no armrest between us, so I'm not lonely～♪ Hehe▼
Mmm... limited expresses really are great！
Yes. It's the Romancecar, after all.
Right, right. The seats are wide, so it's a little lonely, though！
There▼ Not lonely anymore, right？ Hehe！
Ah, Mt. Fuji！ It looks so close...
It's like when we went to Atami...
Yes. Come to think of it... hey.
On the Atami trip, we did it, didn't we？ The honeymoon pretend game.
This time... what should we do？ Since it's a practice trip...
What do you want to do, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. Come to think of it... hey.
On the Atami trip, you didn't do it with me, did you？ The honeymoon pretend game.
Oh... come to think of it.
But this trip is, um, "practice," so I wondered...
What do you want to do, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
(It's a little embarrassing, but I'll do my best...)
Maybe ever since Atami, we've been doing it the whole time.
Wherever we go, it's all "practice" for our honeymoon.
Yeah, come to think of it, maybe so.
Then this time too, let's practice lots▼
We will soon arrive at our final stop, Hakone-Yumoto. For the Hakone Tozan Line toward Gora...
Look, it's already Hakone-Yumoto. There are so few stops, it feels really close.
Shops lined up all the way... amazing...
So, what should we do first？
Let's walk to the Hydrangea Bridge.
Okay... um, I mean, we have to practice, so...
You know, there's something I want to hear when I'm a wife, okay？
Arriving in Hakone made me remember all sorts of things... our last honeymoon.
(Doing it after a while is still embarrassing...)
The Hydrangea Bridge. You can see the Hayakawa River so well...
Ah, there are hydrangeas on the riverbank...
Apparently in June, all of Hakone welcomes tourists with hydrangeas.
Then maybe we'll see lots more？
Yes, I'm sure. I can't wait▼
The Hydrangea Bridge, huh. No hydrangeas blooming, of course？
Hehe, no. But look？ Autumn leaves instead...
A honeymoon, and mountains of autumn leaves...
Yes, maybe we already "rediscovered" something. Honeymoons in Hakone.
I hope we get to see lots of Hakone's autumn leaves.
It's a little early, but let's have lunch around here.
Hmm... soba, I think？ Since we came all the way to Hakone.
Soba, huh. All right, let's find some！
Ah, how about here？ Shall we go here？ Hatsuhana.
Oh, it looks like it has some history！
Yes, seems so. It's often featured on TV... hey, did you read the shop's description？
Their soba is kneaded with just mountain yam and egg, no water.
Here are your "Teijo Soba" and "Tempura Soba." Thank you for waiting.
It's jinenjo soba with grated jinenjo on top. Looks delicious♪
"Teijo Soba," huh. Maybe I should've gotten that...
Well, that's what newlyweds would do, right...？
Thanks for the meal. It was delicious.
Before we go to the Hakone Glass Forest Museum, shall we have lunch？
Yes. Since we're in Hakone, want to go to Hatsuhana again？
▲高嶺＊＊▲ really likes it, huh？ All right, let's go！
Thank you for waiting. Here are your "Teijo Soba" and "Tendon."
It is great！ Yeah... maybe I should've gotten that too...
Geez, again？ Then, you go first？
Well, my husband says he wants to eat it...
Next is the Hakone Glass Forest Museum, huh.
Then we're taking the Hakone Tozan Railway, right？ To Gora！
Ah, the 1000 series！ Um... the Bernina！
Huh！ The cars have names？ You sure know your stuff...
I just happened to know... oh right, hey, let's go look at the water sprinkler tank？
Hey, we're going to the Hakone Tozan Railway next, right？
Yeah. We're going to the "Hakone Glass Forest Museum," so all the way to Gora.
Yeah... now that you mention it, I'm starting to think so too.
Right？ Nice to ride with you again. Do your best, Bernina♪
80 permil... It's a train, but it climbs 80 meters in one kilometer...
That's what you're looking at... Yeah, it is amazing. Look, the hydrangeas are pretty too, see？
Really, so many are blooming... I'm glad we came in a good season.
Ah, look！ The switchback's coming up！
Hey, riding a train up a mountain of autumn leaves like this, it makes you understand, doesn't it？
That in an emergency, you really need a rail clamp brake...
(Doesn't seem to have anything to do with the leaves...)
We're here！ Last stop, Gora Station！
Ah... it's a little cooler up here, after all.
Yeah, we climbed quite a ways.
It's a mountain railway, after all？ It feels like we climbed a mountain. Look, even the station looks like a mountain hut.
You're right！ Now then, let's go to "Hakone Glass Forest Museum".
Yes. Ah... it's a bus from here, right？
Ah, right... you're not good with buses, are you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Will you do "come here" for me again？
Yeah... I can do it now.
We're here！ Last stop, Gora Station！
Ugh, it's a little cold... and windy, too.
Apparently there used to be an outdoor skating rink here...
We take a bus to the "Hakone Glass Forest Museum," right？
Right. Want to rest a bit first？
I'm fine. You know, if you just do that thing for me...
▲高嶺＊＊▲, we'll be there soon. Hang in there！
Okay. I'm glad... I'm with my kind husband.
Did it look like it was just the bus swaying, like I meant it to？
This is Tawaraishi/Hakone Glass Forest. Passengers getting off, please don't forget your belongings...
"Hakone Glass Forest Museum." So this is it...
Wow... It's made of stone and looks like a real old castle.
And see over there！ A glass tree！
It's sparkling！ I see, so that's why it's a glass forest！
Please take your time and enjoy.
Look at this ticket！ It has an interesting shape.
This is Tawaraishi/Hakone Glass Forest. Passengers getting off, please don't forget your belongings...
We made it. The "Hakone Glass Forest Museum"！
The crystal glass tree is pretty again today...
Even knowing it's just the sun reflecting, it's so mysterious...
Please take your time and enjoy.
Look at this ticket？ It's different from last time again. Maybe it changes with the season？
It's beautiful... Apparently the whole museum is themed after Venice.
Come to think of it, there was a Venetian flag at the entrance... but it's so sparkly, it's more like――
Like a world from a fairy tale... you know, the kind where a princess and a prince appear.
It's a hydrangea made of glass...
"Hortensia." It says it uses 2,000 crystal glass beads.
Hehe！ Hey, look？ There are lots of other unusual hydrangeas blooming too！
Whoa... plumes of 100 crystal glass beads each... and 100 plants of it!?
It's autumn in the land of glass. Hehe♪
The Corridor of Light... crystal glass, um... 160,000 beads!?
Hehe, it's swaying in the wind and sparkling. So pretty...
Hey, when we walk through here, let's pretend we're a prince and princess, okay？
You as the princess is fine, but me as the prince too？
W-well then... shall we go, princess？
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you really like it here, huh？
Because... you know, there's a line that often comes at the end of stories, right？
When I was little, I used to imagine it. What kind of place would they live in？
Did you imagine a place like this？
It's a hydrangea made of glass...
"Hortensia." It says it uses 2,000 crystal glass beads.
Hehe！ Hey, look？ There are lots of other unusual hydrangeas blooming too！
Whoa... plumes of 100 crystal glass beads each... and 100 plants of it!?
It's autumn in the land of glass. Hehe♪
It's sparkling today too... almost dazzling.
Then... shall we go, my princess？
Look, a chandelier！ Like a castle's great hall！
Apparently it means "a thousand flowers." A mosaic glass technique dating back to ancient Rome.
You stretch it out and make the pattern smaller and smaller... amazing...
"Covered Goblet with Enameled Flowers." Apparently from around the 16th century...
I wonder if people drank something out of this...
Out of this？ It looks pretty heavy, though... Ah, look at it from behind――
The light shines through, and it looks cobalt blue. So pretty...
So this is the museum shop.
Wow！ Can I take a look？
All sorts of things... Ah, is that "Millefiori"？
Apparently you combine pieces of glass and melt them together. Sounds fun, but...
Why not give it a try？
Done, but... hmm, will this really turn out pretty？
They said firing takes about 70 minutes.
Want to take a break at the restaurant？
It's the "Cafe Terrazza". It's amazing！ It even has live music.
Hehe, is it called "Canzone"？ It feels like we're in Italy, right？
Thank you for waiting. Here is your fruit tea.
There's plenty for the two of us！
Then, pass me your cup？ Let's have some tea. Right, Dear▼
Here you are, thank you for waiting. It turned out very pretty, see？
Thank you very much. Ah, it's pretty！
We still have time. Want to look around a bit more？
Whoa... 45,000 glass beads. I'm slowly running out of surprise.
Hehe！ Ah, hey, over there. What's that？
Like the one at Cape Aijo？
There doesn't seem to be any explanation like that, though...
It's a bell you ring together. Hey, let's ring it？
Um... it's a secret. But I bet it's the same as yours.
Yeah. It's our honeymoon, after all...
Look, the Fontana！ The glass fountain！ It's sparkling.
Oh right, what about the "Bell of Vows"？
Yes. Maybe I'll make a vow again. Hehe！
(All right, then I'll vow, with ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Hey, let's tell each other tomorrow？
That was fun, the Glass Forest...
Looks like you really liked it, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes... being there, it felt like one of my childhood dreams came true.
I see. I'm glad for you.
The bus is here！ Let's go！
I'm fine. I was just thinking about something.
Whether a real honeymoon would be even happier than this. I can't even imagine that...
Next is the last stop, Togendai, Togendai. For the Hakone Ropeway and the pirate ships...
Wow, I can see Lake Ashi！
We're going to board a ship tomorrow, right？ A pirate ship！
Yeah. Today we just head to the hotel.
Nothing... I just remembered... that we're newlyweds.
(When she puts it that way, even I get kind of nervous...)
Look, there it is. This is it, the "Hakone Lake Hotel"！
Ah, right. Then... Manaka, come here？
We made it！ The "Hakone Lake Hotel."
Wow... it's like a hotel abroad... There's a big chandelier, too.
I'm getting a little nervous, maybe...
It'll be fine... I'll go check us in.
I was wondering... will our names be the same？ You know, since it's practice...
Sorry for the wait. I wrote it properly: "▲苗字▲ Manaka."
Thank you for waiting. Now, allow me to explain the hotel's facilities.
Ma'am, please come this way as well.
I'm sorry... I messed up... Dear.
Yeah. Then I'll go check us in.
I wrote it properly, see？ "▲苗字▲ Manaka."
I-it still feels kind of ticklish...
Thank you for waiting. Now, allow me to explain the hotel's facilities.
Ma'am, please come this way as well.
Yes, thank you. Let's go, Dear.
Did I do it well... just kidding.
I'm glad. To be honest, I was a little nervous...
Yes, hehe！ Ah, out the window, the mountains look so close！
You're right. Um, were we supposed to lay out the futons ourselves？
The futons... ah, yeah, I'll do it... it's practice, after all.
I was just thinking this is nice.
My house doesn't have a Japanese-style room, so I've always longed for this kind of thing.
Sitting across a low table, pouring tea for my husband... that's all it is, though.
So that's what it's about, huh...
We've got a little time... want to take a bath first？
The men's bath is "Heaven" and the women's is "Sky"... Oh, there's an open-air bath！
As newlyweds, we could get in togeth...
Geez. Then, meet up at the lobby？
An open-air bath！ This really is great...
Is there one on your side？ Um, like a big cocoon...
A cocoon？ Ah, there's one over here too！
What is it？ A light, maybe... I'll go investigate～！
Hellooo～～. Reporting in～. It was a sauna～.
There's a light inside, and it's super stylish～.
That was your report from Manaka.
Warm up nice and good, Dear▼
Haah～～... That was a nice bath.
Don't look at me too much...
Geez... Hey, let's take a walk around the hotel？
I want to go in！ Okay？
Haah～... it turns you all limp, huh？ Hehe♪
Ahh, that hits the spot... Then, next――
The souvenir corner！ Hey, let's go？
Hakone specialties, huh. There's all kinds of stuff...
So much yosegi marquetry！ It's beautiful. I love it...
Oh, you're right. Local ones？ There's manju, cookies...
Hey, you're hungry, right？ Shall we go eat now？
Did you get hungry when you saw the sweets？
All right, shall we go, then？
Wow... this place feels so grown-up, huh？
Whoa... all right, let's go in.
Thank you for waiting. Here is the "Pork Loin Sanzoku-yaki."
It does. But I'm already full...
You ate a lot today, for you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
I might not be able to finish it all...
Eat lots, my husband？ Here, say "ahh"▼
Thanks for the meal. I'm so full...
Are you okay？ You ate my share too...
I'm fine, I'm fine, I just need to rest a bit！
Then lie down？ I'll give you a massage. Ah, but we already had one earlier――
No, no！ Please, by all means.
Hehe♪ Mm～～, you're so stiff... Then, how about this？ *Rub rub*♪
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you're really good at massages！
Think I'll make a good wife？ Hehe！
Ah... Hey, why don't we go see the lake before it's late？
Come to think of it, we haven't yet. Let's go！
It's already night, huh？ Ah, the hotel...
Yeah, it looks really nice... Hey, shall we go？
Yes... but instead, look, the lights on the far shore are pretty...
Hey, at times like this, what should we talk about？
The future, I guess. Like whether we want a boy or a girl？
Me, hmm... I'd want both. And as many as possible.
Yes. Getting up early every morning, making lunches and breakfast, waking up Papa and the kids...
Hehe, then will you help me？
I want a family that's always together. Everyone eating together, taking baths together...
And once the kids are asleep, we go back to being lovers. Like we are now...
It's night already... Hey, shall we go？
We'll ride it again tomorrow, right？
Last time we rode it, there was a mom and dad with lots of kids.
Both of them were carrying a baby and holding little ones by the hand.
Huh？ Um, it's more like I can't really picture it.
Hehe, I could picture it. You, carrying a little one.
You were a wonderful papa. I bet the mama was happy... just kidding.
Even if we become Papa and Mama, let's always do this, okay？
Huh, now!? Let's not？ It's dark, isn't it dangerous？
It feels like it wouldn't be strange if something came out of that bush...
Oh right, the walking trail！ ...Want to go in？
Because you'll try to scare me...
In movies, a guy with an axe always jumps out from the side, right？
It's okay, it was just a branch！
Okay then... it's still early for bed, but shall we lay out the futons first？
Ah, then I'll lay them out, okay？
But it's practice. That's a wife's job, right？
No, no, it's heavy lifting. Leave this to me！
Hey... I feel like the futons are kind of close...
Are they... I don't think so？ I mean, we're newlyweds！
Is it okay if I take another bath？
It was cold around the lake, so I want to warm up before bed.
(Phew... I keep misreading things on this honeymoon practice...)
Then, see you at the same place as before？
Is it okay if I go in the sauna？ I might be a little late？
Okay！ Then maybe I'll go in too.
Man, this feels great... Haah～, heaven...
A dream!! I almost really went to heaven...
What happened？ You were in the bath a long time？
You didn't get dizzy from the heat？ Your face is red...
(Never again am I dozing off in a hot spring...)
(Nothing else to do, so maybe I'll go to bed？ ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is...)
Shall we go to sleep？ Practice ends here, okay？
Sometimes I wonder myself if my way of thinking is old-fashioned...
But you feel the same way as me... I'm so happy.
You're so kind. I love you.
Hey, let's get in our futons and talk？
(Well... nothing else to do now, just turn off the light and sleep...)
Shall we sleep？ Practice ends here, okay？
A goodnight kiss. Just kidding... hehe▼
(Glad I woke up early. I slept properly last night, after all！)
(I'll let her sleep a little longer...)
Hehe♪ You're fast asleep～. Breakfast is soon～？
Hmm, I feel a little bad, but... here I go～？
Well, this is part of a wife's duties too. Are you awake now？ Dear▼
No, don't, don't look this way...
Geez... you did that on purpose, pervert...
Looks like breakfast has started. Hurry and get changed, my husband？
Okay... sorry for the wait, you can look now？
Looks like breakfast has already started. Hurry and get changed, my husband？
All right, my turn to change！
Ah... the scent of freshly baked bread...
You took quite a lot too, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
It's fine♪ You should eat a lot in the morning. We're going around to lots of places today, right？
Hey, having breakfast on a terrace like this, it's really, you know...
Yes. I've always kind of longed for this.
I see, I'm glad. All right, let's eat.
Okaaay！ Then, like newlyweds... here, say "ahh"▼
Thank you for choosing us. We look forward to seeing you again.
The "Hakone Lake Hotel" sure is a nice hotel.
Yes, I hope we can come again... Hey, why don't we take a photo？
All right！ First, the ropeway to Owakudani！
Sorry for the wait！ I got the tickets.
Thanks. Hey, did you see that？
Look, two ropes. They pull it with those ropes...
You're right. It is a ropeway, after all.
You get impressed by the strangest things... Come on, let's line up！
The weather's nice again today, so we can enjoy a walk in the sky！
Ah, right... you're not good with looking down, are you？ ...You okay？
I'm fine. My husband's with me, after all... just kidding.
Steam's shooting out of the ground！ Look, look！
...You seem kind of down. You okay？
I-I'm fine. It's just a little too high... just kidding.
You're not good with heights, huh... Here, come here, Manaka？
Thank you. I'm glad my husband is so dependable▼
We will soon arrive at Owakudani Station. For the ropeway toward Sounzan...
Whoa... what an amazing view... You okay, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
As long as I hold on like this, I'm fine.
Hey, look？ Mt. Fuji is so big...
We will soon arrive at Owakudani Station. For the ropeway toward Sounzan...
We're here... whoa, so this is Owakudani!!
Amazing... I can see why it used to be called Jigokudani, "Hell Valley"...
Yeah, it's strong... hydrogen sulfide, I guess？
You add hydrochloric acid to iron sulfide, right？ Didn't you try it as an experiment in junior high？
From here, they send hot spring water through steel pipes 2,600 m long, with a 350 m drop...
Huh～！ I see... Want to see more？
Amazing... so much steam coming out of the ground. It's an active volcano, after all...
Hehe, this is great♪ Hey, let's hurry！
Yes, hydrogen sulfide reacts with iron and forms iron sulfide... that's why the black eggs are that color, too...
So much steam... it keeps 80-degree water boiling nonstop...
Raising 1 cc of water by one degree takes 1 calorie, right？ So that means...
How much heat would that be？ I guess――
Um... want to check out the other spots？
Show it to me！ Oh, it really is black！ Amazing！
I wonder if that's iron sulfide on them.
Alright, let's eat！ It's hot, so be careful.
Yeah... my heart's pounding, but holding on like this makes me feel safe...
So this is what a honeymoon is like... just kidding▼
We will soon arrive at Togendai Station. For the Hakone Pirate Ship to Hakone-machi...
It's a little early, but let's have lunch here before boarding the pirate ship？
Let's. I wonder if we can see the lake？
Whoa... lots on the menu！ What'll you get？
Me？ Um, then... hm？ That！ I'll get that！
Ginger saute. Look, the pork looks delicious.
Huh... so it's a special kind of pork. Looks tasty, huh？
Good, huh？ Think you can eat it all？
Help me？ I can't finish it. Here, say "ahh"♪
Today, maybe I'll have the katsu curry. It comes with salad, too.
It's delicious♪ But it's a bit much, so help me？
Oh, come on... you just want to eat it all！
It's true！ Really！ Come on, help me？
It's so big... is it life-size？
Excited shivers. I remembered a pirate book I read in elementary school. Hey, let's get on？
It's big... 35 meters long and 315 tons, after all...
Huh？ Yeah, kind of... Not very newlywed-like, is it？
Um... I didn't memorize its top speed, though.
Whoa, 3D art of pirate paintings！ It looks like it's popping out！
Looking for a spot where you can see the engine room！ It has two 575-horsepower engines！
Hey, let's go out on deck and take a photo？
Haah... feels nice... so wide, like the sea...
When I was a kid, every time a pirate appeared in a book, I'd think, "I wish I were a boy"...
Because as a girl, it's hard to imagine myself becoming a pirate.
Right. But right now, I feel a little like a pirate. Hehe♪
From here we walk to Hakone Shrine, right？ We could see the torii from the boat, huh？
It really does stand in the water.
Apparently it welcomes the dragon god from the lake. Look, it faces the lake.
It was built in 1952 to commemorate the San Francisco Peace Treaty...
It bears a plaque reading "Peace" by Prime Minister Yoshida, and is beloved as the Torii of Peace.
I see... this is kind of turning into a school trip, huh？
Ah... do you not like this kind of thing？ It's not very honeymoon-ish, is it？
Isn't it fine？ A honeymoon with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ would definitely turn out like this, right？
Ah, the pirate ship！ Yoo-hoo... just kidding...
We're newlyweds, right？ This is a little weird, isn't it？
It's very you, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. That kind of honeymoon is good too.
Oh, the autumn leaves！ Wow, they're so red... just kidding...
Hehe, hang in there？ Look, almost there！
Made it！ So this is Hakone Shrine！
This shrine was founded in 757 by the priest Mangan, following an oracle from the great god of Hakone...
With the fusion of Shinto and Buddhism, it came to be worshipped as Hakone Gongen.
Shinbutsu... I see！ You really studied up, huh？
Ahem！ Hey, let's go to Kuzuryu Shrine too？
The dragon god water, huh... The dragon really does have nine heads.
Enoshima had a five-headed dragon, right？
Hehe, I don't know, but like in Enoshima――
It seems to bring luck in love, too...
Then, shall we make a wish？
May the two of us always be able to be like this...
Hehe, good work. We've come again, great god of Hakone.
